outcome: People run the leadership report (Tuesday and monthly) live on the shared work item page
acceptance_criteria: Starting a Tuesday report: pick project `C-LR-1`, report "Internal Tuesday", From and To, Reference, leave all six Include boxes checked, press Start; the request is `POST /api/v1/projects/C-LR-1/leadership-report-intake` with exactly `{action:"start", case_revision, key, reference, background:false, selection:{template_id, start_at, end_at, kind:"internal_tuesday", audience:"internal", scope:{domains:[six]}}, sections:null}` and `X-CSRFToken`, and the page lands on `/work/4201` — verify: unit test on `buildBody`, mock request log in `e2e/leadership-report-live.spec.ts`.
The start body never contains `selections`, `content_id`, record ids, `include` flags or any key not listed above — verify: unit test asserts exact key set.
Monthly asks for Audience with two options and none preselected; Start stays disabled until it is chosen; Tuesday shows "Internal" and cannot change it — verify: component test.

With `C-LR-2` (`all_projects_available:false`) the no-access sentence is shown and the form still starts; with `C-LR-1` the other sentence is shown; neither shows a project list or record picker — verify: e2e on both; grep the form files for `sources` use shows none beyond the hook's read.
Template: one template is preselected "Test template v1"; none shows "No template" and sends `template_id:null`; several require a choice — verify: component test on the three intake fixtures.
To before From, empty Reference, zero Include boxes and an unchosen kind each block the press with a message beside the field, and no request is sent — verify: component test counts fetch calls.

A 422 with `fields[{name:"reference"}]` shows the message beside Reference; a 409 re-reads `case_revision` and says the project changed; 429 and 503 say "Try again shortly."; a dropped network after the press says the start could not be confirmed and a second press sends the same `key` — verify: mock scenarios and a unit test comparing the two request keys.
A 403 `csrf_failed` on start refreshes the session once and does not show the no-access state — verify: mock scenario plus unit test counting fetches.

`/work/4201` (drafting) shows the state tag, `current_activity.label`, the "left out" sentence naming the project with `unavailable_domains`, and no step list, no "step N of M", no count of milestones or invoices, no "Send for leadership review" and no "Ask Tola" — verify: e2e; DOM assertions for those absences.

`/work/4202` shows five sections in the API order with their coverage tags; the section with `coverage:"unknown"` and empty text reads "Not recorded" and "Unknown", and no text is filled in — verify: e2e and adapter unit test.

The counts block on `/work/4202` shows Meetings 41, Issues 12, Milestones 3, Escalations 2 each "in this report", and Actions and Changes read "Not recorded" (never 0); "As of" shows `captured_at` in the viewer's timezone; "Projects covered: 5" has no "of"; there is no Invoices row; no total is shown — verify: e2e and unit test (`counts` missing a domain).
Scope words: `all_psl_projects` reads "All PSL projects", `approved_project_scope` "Your approved projects", `selected_records` "Selected records" — verify: unit test.

On `/work/4202` three buttons appear in the order Approve and send, Return with a note, Refuse; with `review_verdicts:["approve"]` only Approve appears; with `[]` none appears and no decide card — verify: e2e on three variants.
Return and Refuse with an empty note are blocked before any request, with the message beside the note; Approve with an empty note is allowed — verify: component test counts fetch calls.

Approve sends exactly one `POST /api/v1/work/4202/reviews` `{kind:"document", expected_revision:7, case_revision:12, version_id:9001, verdict:"approve", note}`; buttons are disabled while it is in flight; after the 200 the page re-reads and shows the new state — verify: e2e request log (count is 1) and unit test.

A 409 on review shows "This report changed. Read the new version before deciding." and re-reads both reads; a 403 shows "You can't decide this review."; a network drop after the press re-reads, locks the buttons with the "couldn't confirm" text, and unlocks only when the re-read still shows the same `document_version_id` with verdicts offered — verify: mock scenarios and unit test.

When `expected_revision`, `case_revision` or `document_version_id` is null, the decide buttons are disabled with "This report can't be decided right now." and no request is sent; a null is never sent as 0 — verify: unit test on the command descriptor (`body()` keeps null).

With `can_correct:true` the "Edit the report" form opens with the existing text, requires a Reason, and sends `POST /api/v1/work/{id}/leadership-report` with the readback tokens, all sections, unchanged `evidence_ids` and `coverage`, and a `selection` with no `scope.mode`, `scope.actor` or `scope.configuration`; with `can_correct:false` there is no Edit control — verify: unit test on the body; e2e on both fixtures.
A 409 on edit keeps the typed text in the form and says it was kept — verify: component test.

`/work/4203` (Tuesday) shows sections Progress, Risks, Blockers, Dependencies, the counts block, and a decide card only if `review_verdicts[]` is non-empty (here empty: none). No page text says "no review", "published without review" or "review required" — verify: e2e DOM text assertion.

Recipients: `receipt_id:null` rows read "No receipt yet" with their `status`; rows with a receipt read "Receipt recorded" and the `recorded_at` time; the "Received by every recipient" line shows only when state is `verified` and every row has a receipt (`/work/4204` shows it; `/work/4203` does not) — verify: e2e on both; adapter unit test.

`/work/4203` shows F-87's "Check what happened" because `actions[]` has `reconcile`; pressing it sends `POST /work/4203/actions` `{expected_revision, action:"reconcile"}` once and re-reads; `/work/4204` shows no such button; there is no Resend, Send again or Try sending control anywhere in this feature — verify: e2e request log; grep for those words in the new files returns nothing.
`/work/4204` shows the "Open the report" link only through `output_url`; `/work/4202` with `output_url:null` shows none — verify: e2e on both.
`/work/4206` and a live id the account cannot see both show exactly "This record is unavailable." — verify: open both and compare text.
A 401 on any read or write shows the signed-out state with `/sign-in?next=<current path>` — verify: sign out in the mock, open `/work/4202`.

A `panels[]` entry with key `leadership-report` on a work item loads through `adapterFor`; the adapter registers once; `commands()` returns `leadership-report.correct` and `leadership-report.review`, the review one with `idempotency.field === null` and no key in its body — verify: `leadershipReportAdapter.test.ts`; typecheck passes.

Against live Django (account with PMO Lead or Finance Lead authority, port 8020), the intake read, a start, the readback and one review show the same fields and counts as `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/leadership-report` — verify: compare the page with the `curl` JSON, and record in the PR the live values of `all_projects_available`, `automatic_project_scope` and the live panel key.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390: setup, drafting, review, Tuesday and received render without horizontal scroll, targets at least 44 px on phone, no empty heading or gap where a part is absent, and `axe` (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22aa) has no violations — verify: screenshots against the SCR-52 artboards and the e2e axe run.

Wrong-person and wrong-tenant cases: a user without access to the work gets the 404 state; a user whose `review_verdicts[]` is empty sees no decide card and cannot reach a decide request from the page; nothing in the page decides access client-side — verify: e2e with two mock personas.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` pass and `api-live-schema-drift.test.ts` is unchanged — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: Medium. The builder has to reshape three setup choices into the live intake (D-33), render narrative sections with coverage, and drive review, send and reconcile on a shared adapter. That is a cross-layer contract (design/screens.md SCR-52, connect map section SCR-52). It is not high risk because it adds no data, money, identity change or migration, and the backend enforces permissions and delivery. Surfaces include external-messaging (the report is sent to recipients) and product-decision (the meaning of the counts and coverage markers). The design is approved under the recorded exception in design/review.json, which covers only the design engineer's upload-concepts change and not SCR-52. Client acceptance is required because it is a new flow with new copy.
